name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says 'Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.' The second sentence is a command with an order implied by 'in the other room' only as location, but the task's ordering is sequential: open the door, then pick up the box. The clauses Existence(door_open) and Existence(target_picked_up) are both hard and present, but they omit the order between them. Add a hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) so the box is picked up only after the door has been opened. Also, the target box cannot be reached without the door per the environment constraints, so the order is the only missing requirement. Keep both existing Existence clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard matches the task's command to open the door and then pick up the box. The hard chain forces door_open, so no separate Existence(door_open) is needed, and the clues list door_open as required.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room: the agent must end up carrying the mission's target box.
Open the door before picking up the box: the box may be picked up only after the door has been opened.
